newsitem.title: UK: HORSE RACING-ACCEPTORS FOR THE EPSOM DERBY.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-ACCEPTORS FOR THE EPSOM DERBY.

the Epsom Derby to be run over 12 furlongs (2.4 kms) on Saturday
